notes.title: Collaboration Bundle with Girls Maid Pudding Now Available!

Starting today, we are pleased to announce the release of a special collaboration bundle with Girls Maid Pudding, created by Kazuhide Oka and published under ANMC (Anomachi).

The bundle is titled 《Indie Girls Story Bundle》
This special set includes Girls Maid Pudding and Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo.
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59606/_/

Girls Maid Pudding is a touring ADV where two girls travel by motorcycle, cooking and chatting as they uncover the mysteries of the world.

notes.title: Thank You for the Release, Patch Update, and Future Plans
notes.content:
To all players,
This is MYU, director of Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo.

On Wednesday, September 17, we successfully released the game. Two days have now passed since launch, and many people have already played it and shared their impressions and reactions on social media and other platforms. It finally feels real that the game has launched, and I am once again reminded that we could only reach this point thanks to everyone’s support. I want to express my heartfelt gratitude!

We carefully read every comment shared through Steam reviews, community posts, and social media. While we are encouraged by the many voices enjoying the game, we have also received reports of bugs and localization issues. We are reviewing these now and preparing to address them as quickly as possible through patch updates.

Based on the issues pointed out in reviews and community posts, we have made urgent fixes today and released a patch that includes bug fixes and localization adjustments.

v1.0.1: Localization and Bug Fixes
＝＝＝
Fixes

Corrected parts of the English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese localization.

Fixed an issue in CHAPTER 1-3 where the movie would not play.

Improved image quality and design of Steam achievement icons (Steam restart recommended).
＝＝＝

As for future updates:
We have received feedback that the English localization feels unnatural. In coordination with our publisher, we plan to review and revise the overall text, with a major update scheduled for the future.
In addition, we are investigating other improvement requests from players to see what can be addressed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/38892d8ce9a7c8864c9cb40a051112c3cd1851c7.png[/img]

Next week, I will personally be attending TGS and standing at our booth. I am very much looking forward to meeting you in person and talking about the game!

With all of your feedback in mind, we will continue to work hard to improve the game so that it can be enjoyed more comfortably and without stress.
Thank you again for your continued support of Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo!

First of all, I would like to express my deepest gratitude once again to all the fans who have supported us, to those who joined our feedback campaign and beta test, and to everyone who helped bring this project to life.  

[b]We are also running a special launch sale right now—don’t miss this chance to enjoy the game![/b]

This is a mystery-focused adventure game, but for those times when you may get stuck, we’ve prepared an ""Exploration Guide.""

notes.title: 【Noise Report #27】Release Date Set for September 17, 2025!
notes.content:
To everyone,
This is MYU, the director.

At last, the day has come when I can finally share this news with you.
Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo will be released on September 17, 2025!!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/2260adf27bd7f9f64bd9514b9aa8c78b04e03898.png[/img]
I’m truly thrilled to finally make this announcement.

Thanks to your participation in the demo and Steam reviews, we’ve received many supportive messages and honest feedback.
To everyone who helped us — thank you so much.

We’re currently polishing the final version based on your input, and the game is now 90% complete.
We’ve entered the final phase of refinement and finishing touches for release.

To bring this title to even more people, we have decided to distribute a Playtest version and strengthen our Steam fan community.
We are committed to making Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo an even more exciting and captivating experience.
We truly appreciate your continued support and cooperation!

Please note that the Playtest version contains the same content as the currently available Demo.
Whether you are playing Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo for the first time or have already played the Demo, we would love for you to join us.
Your feedback and opinions will help shape the final product.

Specifically, we’ll be gathering feedback and opinions on our Discord server:

◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥
Discord
https://discord.gg/bTMrxgtchv
◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥

Starting today, we’ve also released the official release date trailer.
Around the same time, we’ll be appearing at bilibili world (China) and running a wishlist campaign to bring the game to more players.

Only two months left until launch.
We’re sprinting to the finish—thank you again for your continued support!

— MYU

notes.title: 【Noise Report #24】Updates on “Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo” Improvements
notes.content:
The total number of opinions and feedback collected through the demo campaign was "171 submissions."
We were pleasantly surprised by the overwhelming number of responses we received. Thank you so much for your participation!

Based on the reviews and feedback so far, we are taking all your opinions seriously and will continue to work on improvements and refinement.
In line with this, we would like to share our roadmap for functional improvements towards the full version of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/77994d1c1d61e914e0202fab9667c4c46300d3c8.png[/img]

[b]Roadmap for “Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo” Full Version[/b]
◆ Key Feature Improvements
Viewing keywords seen in the noise
Distinguishing already clicked objects during scanning
Displaying hints for possible next actions during exploration (can be toggled ON/OFF)
Indications for item synthesis and noise analysis availability

◆ Other System and Feature Refinements
Modify the specification where equipped items change when obtaining other items
Adjust volume balance for BGM and SE
Improve visibility of object names when hovering over them in exploration mode
Adjust processing time for dial puzzles
Add fade transitions when switching BGM
Other bug fixes and overall experience improvements.

From the entire development team.

notes.title: 【Noise Report #19】StatusUpdate!
notes.content:
Hello, this is MYU.
How are you all doing?
Currently, Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo is in full development!

Recently, I’ve been attending various events, including TGS 2024, tissue distribution in Akihabara, and a pitch event for publishers.
Let me share my experiences with you this time.

◆ TGS 2024
TGS is one of the biggest game events, but since it's held in Tokyo, I hadn’t had the chance to attend before. This year was my first time!
In addition to that, I had several appointments with companies, and we had some good discussions. And that pretty much sums up my TGS experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/acb34322ac084674905d5c96fa8bb9e9df96eda1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/a3fa6cff47cbf86fbc6cf09dbf6299abc8a28db3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/2ee170da03e89a871374269ba423acd63dac031f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/3eab44decf94de60b9b8d4194ef61163759d3734.jpg[/img]
However, I did notice there seemed to be a lot of indie games this year. Since it was my first time, I can’t say for sure if there were more than usual, but I did hear some people mentioning how indie games were quite abundant. This just shows how much the indie game scene is booming these days.
Unfortunately, I couldn't exhibit my game this time, but I’m aiming for next year!

I got some great inspiration, and I plan to channel that into my development!

◆ Publisher Pitch Event: "Sakura Game Pitch"
Sakura Game Pitch is an event where indie developers present their games to domestic and international publishers. It's co-hosted by 404 Not Found, a hub for indie creators that opened this July in Shibuya.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/22f7872038aa29ee3c2b5f96be534398bfa93cf7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/bdab85cf3e1776d4635ac3fc49e5b9e85ff36616.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/0d75cc02dbc76770a0592240ef4fa6ce97eb194f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/1d198e9bf7a9e5417df29c355cd20ab01e8c10a6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/bfd298963f4cd246bb0137e3dd2a776fccc358a1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/8928d920e68599818cdd47d0ed14fb3ab7043072.png[/img]
Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo was selected, so I went to Shibuya to give a presentation and meet with publishers.
I delivered the presentation in Japanese while it was simultaneously translated into English, which helped me keep a relaxed pace and enjoy the process.

During the networking session after the presentation, the concept of trauma in our game seemed to resonate with people, and I managed to hand out tissues to promote the game. It felt like a lot of people were interested!

I’m looking forward to continuing discussions with several companies.

◆ Akihabara Tissue Distribution Campaign: Fourth Round!
In an ongoing effort to raise awareness of my game Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo, I handed out tissues in Akihabara.

Date: October 28, 2024
Location: Around Akihabara Station
Time: 3:00 PM until all tissues are distributed
Items: Tissues with flyers including a QR code linking to the Steam store page (approx. 250 packs)
Permission was obtained from the local police station.
I even had a few people come up and say, “I’ve been waiting for this!” and others who seemed curious and started conversations. It made me really happy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/7feec8400e2f20400981d0e658688cbf38c240d6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/9daf8e738c2f5dda9dd965a3c22d863443a58605.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/1ea3963ef6162eb96973c5532c7b8ed8d52a9000.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/b2fb5cbc9ba6227cf255ec0cf2aaa6bcaa737ce3.png[/img]
So, what about the Steam store page access numbers for October 28? Unfortunately, they went down...
Results

Data gathered from Steam on the 28th:
Access: Decreased by about 25.73%
1st round: +14.84%
2nd round: +36.65%
3rd round: +212.08%
4th round: -25.73%

It’s not always easy, huh...
It seems like the lack of recent events or noticeable exposure has led to a drop in access. I've also been pretty swamped with development lately, and I haven’t posted on my note or social media in 3 or 4 weeks.
Still, I feel like this kind of result is pretty typical for tissue distribution. I’m not discouraged, and I’ll keep pushing forward!

We have an official Discord server, "Noise Scramble City," so if you're interested, please take a look!
https://discord.gg/C3YMKVBvbV

See you next time!
Don't forget to add us to your wishlist if you haven't already!

notes.title: [Noise Report #1]Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo Steam Store Release
notes.content:
Hello, I'm MYU.
I am responsible for planning, scenario writing, character design, and direction for this project.

Escape from a noise-filled city. A noise-canceling adventure combining puzzles and story interaction.
Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo
was introduced today at INDIELiveExpo  on May 25, 2024.

In this Noise Report, we will regularly share the latest development information and news!

"Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo" scheduled for release in 2024, is currently under intense development.
We've spent a lot of time preparing for today... It's just the beginning, but I'm thrilled to finally have it available on the store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/6c6a91e7acde256945edde9f5bcbe77e8fd1de8e.png[/img]

We will be sharing information with you in real time as we continue development, and I hope you enjoy this dynamic process.
I've spent more of my life drawing pictures than writing, so some parts may be a bit difficult to read, but I'll do my best!

From next time, we will focus more on the content of the work, introducing characters and gameplay elements!
We plan to post something related to development weekly, so please follow and stay tuned!!
◆We have also opened a Discord server, "Noise Scramble City" today. Feel free to join!
https://discord.gg/C3YMKVBvbV

Also, we would be thrilled if you add the game to your wishlist!!
Thank you very much!!
